caseNameFull: Pearlman, Trustee in Bankruptcy v. Reliance Insurance Co.
attorneys: David Morgulas for the Association of Casualty and Surety Companies, and Edward M. Murphy, pro se, on the motions.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 369 U. S. 847, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. The motions of the Association of Casualty and Surety Companies and Edward M. Murphy for leave to file briefs, as amici curiae, are granted.
